notes_for_editor: The only Mount Harriman evidence is one row in the FFLA county table (Orange, platform tower, Gone, 41.30326 -74.11430), which matches the brief record. No Mount Harriman-specific page was found, and the NY chapter alphabetical list has no Harriman Mt entry (text search found none). So there is no build date, height, staffing or removal date for it. The Jackie Jones tower is a separate structure: the county list gives it a different county (Rockland) and different coordinates, and the chapter lists it separately, so the story does not use it as Mount Harriman's history. Conflicts about the Jackie Jones tower are left open for the editor: the chapter homepage says closed pending inspections, the chapter tower list says standing, open to the public and restored in 2019, and the November 2021 hiking post says the tower was not open to the public before 2018 and is now fenced off and closed. The county list puts Jackie Jones in Rockland while the hike write-up says Harriman State Park. Kind (platform) and county match the record; no corrections.
